name: motion-image-reveal-slider
description: Marketing still with a draggable rail that reveals a color photograph from a grayscale overlay, or compares two images.
purpose: Lets a landing page show a before-and-after or color-versus-mono photograph as a single interactive frame instead of two static tiles.
avoidFor: galleries that need independent captions per still
